about: Engine KV tokens per replica (vllm.Engine.KVCacheCapacity) against the vLLM engine core's logged 'GPU KV cache size: N tokens', for the fit units of the published ledger whose server log prints it. end_to_end sizes the pool from the kernel's own memory estimate; pinned sizes it from the logged 'Available KV cache memory' (kv_cache_memory_bytes), which isolates the pool's structure from the memory terms. tolerance is the tier above today's largest |ratio - 1| in the group (3, 5, 10, 15, 25, 50, 100, 400 percent). formula says whether the logged build computes the figure as v0.33.0 does (vLLM >= 0.28) or not.
